title: Measures to Reduce Indiscriminate Parking of Shared Bicycles
what_it_is: Measures to Reduce Indiscriminate Parking of Shared Bicycles

sections.label: Bicycle sharing enforcement and licensing
sections.summary: LTA issued over 2,100 removal notices and collected about $180,000 in fines and fees since May 2017, and will propose licensing amendments.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Since enforcement commenced in May 2017, LTA has issued more than 2,100 removal notices and collected about $180,000 in fines and administrative fees from the Bicycle Sharing Operators (BSOs).

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: LTA will also be proposing legislative amendments later this month to put in place a licensing framework for BSOs.

sections.label: Shared bicycle parking areas
sections.summary: All Government agencies and Town Councils allow shared bicycles in public bicycle parking areas, with about 174,000 lots and 50,000 more planned by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In fact, all Government agencies and Town Councils allow shared bicycles to be parked in all public bicycle parking areas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: There are currently about 174,000 bicycle parking lots available, and we plan to add another 50,000 by 2020.

sections.label: Fine amounts for offences
sections.summary: The fine is $100 for the first offence, $200 for the second offence and $500 for subsequent offences.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In fact, the fine ranges from $100 for the first offence, $200 for the second offence and $500 for subsequent offences.

sections.label: Licensing framework for bicycle operators
sections.summary: The speaker agrees BSOs are not performing up to desired outcomes, which is why legislative amendments for a licensing framework will be proposed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Indeed, I agree with Mr Pritam Singh that the BSOs are not performing up to the desired outcomes that LTA would want them to.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This is the reason why we will be proposing legislative amendments to put in place a licensing framework for BSOs.

sections.label: Discussions on optimum fleet size
sections.summary: The speaker states they discuss with the BSOs the optimum fleet size that will meet Singaporeans' requirements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: At the same time, we do discuss with the BSOs with regard to the optimum fleet size that will meet the requirements of Singaporeans.

sections.label: Shared bikes blocking estate areas
sections.summary: Residents encountered shared bikes blocking fire exits and wheelchair ramps, and the legislative amendments and framework address this.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: I raise this because my residents have encountered these shared bikes blocking fire exits, wheelchair ramps and other essential parts of the estate, and they are worried that the companies are socialising the costs while privatising the profits.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This is exactly the intent of the legislative amendments and the framework that we will be coming up with.

sections.label: BSOs bicycle rental disincentives
sections.summary: Under the new legislative framework, BSOs are expected to impose some form of disincentive for renting out bicycles.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: With the new legislative framework, we do want the BSOs to impose some form of disincentive with regard to renting out of the bicycles.
